verdict.rationale: Generating llms.txt is a fair question for a static docs-site generator, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Docusaurus emitting llms.txt or a full-content variant at build time. The probe found that Docusaurus's own site returns 404 for /llms.txt and /docs.md, and while the plugin architecture is documented, no llms.txt plugin is evidenced.
